title: Think-tank conference on crash retrievals by Russia, China and the US
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Think-tank conference on crash retrievals by Russia, China and the US, about an unknown time at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: let's assume that there have been crash revals by Russia China and the United States

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, relays something told to him by Hal Puthoff, a physicist long involved in government research on unusual phenomena. According to Michels, a think-tank meeting in Washington DC worked from the premise that Russia, China and the United States had each recovered crashed craft of non-human origin. If true, it would mean several rival powers are quietly holding such material.
